_comment: EXAMPLE board list. ATS boards are per-company, not a global search, so THIS LIST IS YOUR COVERAGE — the tool can only see companies named here. Copy to companies.json and grow it with `npm run discover -- <slug>`, which probes a slug against Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby and only keeps the ones that resolve. tier and stage feed the prescore boosts below; set them to reflect who you actually want to work for.

stageBoost._comment: Measured 2026-08-14 over 108 honestly-scored roles: startups are 6% legally reachable (1 of 17), scaleups 38% (30 of 79). The old +14 startup boost was written on a true belief about FIT — a small team really is likelier to want a generalist who owns a system end to end — and a false one about ODDS. A twelve-person company cannot afford to employ someone in Nigeria; a 300-person one often can. The prescore decides who gets READ, and reads are the scarce resource (the free daily quota), so spending them on a 6%-reachable category is waste. Large stayed near neutral rather than penalised: only 5 samples, and Canonical is large and hires on every continent.

candidates._comment: Slugs already probed, kept so the same dead ends are not retried. notFound = no public board; usOnly / platformsThatExcludeAfrica = a board exists but cannot employ where you are.
